title: Bitcoin development activity increases with new BIP proposal
content: <div class="tldr-section"><em><strong>TL;DR: Bitcoin's core development is surging, with new BIP proposals signaling a robust, self-improving protocol vital for individual sovereignty. This quiet but profound activity, underpinned by a resilient network operating at Block 934,771 with a current hashrate of 876.31 EH/s, reinforces Bitcoin's unassailable position as the hardest money. For transactors, this means not only enhanced security but also future possibilities for more sophisticated self-custody and efficient transactions, demanding
